name: jevbrain
description: Select an eligible registered sub-agent profile with Jevbrain.

interface.shortDescription: Route approved delegations to registered profiles.
interface.longDescription: Jevbrain filters a trusted profile registry and asks Jev to select an eligible profile after the main session decides to delegate. The host still owns execution, permissions, and verification.
defaultPrompt: Route this approved delegation with Jevbrain.
Explain the eligible profile selection for this task.
